corpus.permitted_source: Open Food Facts selected nutrition_en raw source images from the public AWS image dataset

selection.algorithm: On the frozen eligible public inventory, sort by SHA-256 of UTF-8 'printed-panel-v2-gate-v1:' + image_sha256 + ':' + panel_id; select the first 100, assign the first 60 to tuning and the last 40 to untouched_gate. Freeze these identities and assignments before human ground-truth review or v2 recognition.
selection.candidate_eligibility: Use the Open Food Facts selected nutrition_en role to record its revision and raw imgid, then download the untransformed raw image from the public AWS dataset and freeze its SHA-256, licence and panel ID. Record source-only exclusions before selecting 100. Hash mismatch, non-food or absent nutrition image may be excluded; difficult but valid panels remain as potential declines. If the selected set later misses adequacy minima, invalidate the gate and version a new selection rather than substituting cases.

scoring.match_key: Canonical nutrient and unambiguous semantic column basis plus header relationship; duplicate same-basis columns require distinct verified semantic headers and never earn credit by list order.
scoring.normalization: Unicode NFC and collapsed whitespace for labels only; do not rewrite numeric decimal text, comparator, unit, basis or serving conversion for exact scoring.
scoring.numeric_cell_exact_denominator: Every printed numeric product cell in each usable untouched table; missing candidates remain in the denominator and extra candidates reduce complete-table exactness.
scoring.full_table_exact_denominator: Every non-declined untouched table; all expected rows, parent relationships, semantic headers, cells, bounds and bases must match with no extra accepted cell.
scoring.bound_denominator: Every printed bounded product cell, not reference-intake constants; an unbound or exact-valued replacement fails.
scoring.serving_conversion_denominator: Every printed serving conversion; null, unknown or inferred ratios do not earn exact credit.
scoring.false_ready: Any incorrect, incomplete, extra or unbound proposed table marked ready_for_confirmation, whether or not a warning is displayed; any automatic persistence is a separate critical failure.
scoring.correct_decline_denominator: Every human-verified required-decline case in the untouched set; a decline on a usable table is separately reported as a false decline.
scoring.arithmetic_faults: Pre-registered factor-ten serving mutation, per-100/per-serving header transposition and exact-value replacement of a printed bound; each mutation is generated from real verified truth.
scoring.zero_or_missing_critical_denominator: Gate invalid; do not report a vacuous pass.
